result.summary: Kestrel Marine Parts Ltd has one open overdue invoice of $70k, now 38 days past due (original due 2026-10-16), against a single TCI policy with a $500k limit. The prior notification from the same policy (resolved 12 days late in July 2026) shows the overdue period has roughly tripled, and notification frequency has risen from 0 to 2 in the last six months. While exposure remains well within the credit line and only one policy is reporting, the lengthening delay warrants closer monitoring before further limit extension.
concerns: Days past due increased from 12 (resolved) to 38 (still open) on consecutive notifications
Notification frequency rising (0 to 2 in last 180 days) from the same policy
Current overdue ($70k) plus not-yet-due exposure ($95k) together represent meaningful utilization of the $500k limit
